issue: Add input validation for blank usernames.
acceptance: Blank usernames should be rejected and existing tests must pass.

issue: The date parser throws an unhandled exception on empty strings instead of returning None.
acceptance: Passing an empty or whitespace-only string returns None without raising.

issue: Add pagination support to the list_items function (page and page_size params).
acceptance: list_items accepts page and page_size and returns the correct slice.

issue: Fix off-by-one error in the retry backoff calculation causing one extra retry.
acceptance: The number of retries matches max_retries exactly.

issue: Add a rate limiter decorator that raises a clear error when a function is called more than N times per minute.
acceptance: Calls beyond the limit raise RateLimitExceeded.

issue: String slugify function does not strip leading/trailing hyphens when input starts or ends with special characters.
acceptance: slugify never returns leading or trailing hyphens.

issue: Add support for parsing config values from environment variables as a fallback when not present in the config file.
acceptance: File values take precedence over environment fallback values.

issue: CSV export function crashes when a field contains a comma or newline.
acceptance: Fields containing commas or quotes are correctly escaped.

issue: Add a caching layer (simple in-memory TTL cache) to the expensive_lookup function.
acceptance: Repeated calls with the same arguments use a cached result.

issue: The password strength checker incorrectly accepts passwords with only repeated characters.
acceptance: Passwords consisting of a single repeated character are rejected.

issue: Refactor duplicated error-handling logic in three API client methods into a shared decorator or helper.
acceptance: Behavior is unchanged and duplication is removed.

issue: JSON serialization fails on datetime objects with a TypeError instead of encoding them as ISO 8601 strings.
acceptance: Datetime fields serialize to ISO 8601 strings.

issue: Add a --dry-run flag to the CLI delete command that shows what would be deleted without deleting anything.
acceptance: With dry_run no items are removed; normal behavior is unchanged.

issue: The search function is case-sensitive, but users expect case-insensitive matching.
Sorting function is unstable when comparing items with equal keys, causing inconsistent output order across runs.
acceptance: Equal-key items retain original relative order.
